flags.why: Lân remains current in everyday discussion of fertilisers and plant nutrients.
Lân cận means neighbouring and does not illustrate the verb meaning to encroach.
flags.fix: Anh ấy ngồi lân sang chỗ của tôi. = He encroached on my space while sitting.

flags.why: Đắt đỏ is used throughout Vietnam, rather than mainly in the North.
The common meaning housework or homemaking is missing and is the meaning used in the first example.
Ẩn dật is a literary expression for living in seclusion and needs a register warning.
The adjective retains the literary register of the word.
The common meaning of scraping against or sideswiping something, especially in traffic, is missing.
flags.fix: Add verb: to scrape against; to sideswipe.
